claims: The letter 'o' is the 15th letter in the English alphabet.
The letter 'o' is the 4th vowel in the English alphabet.
The letter 'o' typically represents a long sound (/oʊ/ as in "boat").
The letter 'o' typically represents a short sound (/ɒ/ or /ɑ/ as in "fox").
The letter 'o' is visually represented as a circle (O/o).
The letter 'o' is used to denote zero.
The letter 'o' is used to denote the blood type O.
Long 'o' is pronounced /oʊ/ as in boat, soap, or open.
Short 'o' is pronounced /ɒ/ in British English (as in "fox").
Short 'o' is pronounced /ɑ/ or /a/ in American English.
The letter 'o' is derived from the Semitic letter ʿayin.
The Semitic letter ʿayin represents an eye.
The letter 'o' was adopted by the Greeks (omicron).
The letter 'o' is the 4th most common letter in the English alphabet.
The letter 'o' is formed by starting at the top and drawing a continuous circle.
The capital (O) and lowercase (o) are similar in shape.
'O' represents the chemical symbol for oxygen.
